name: get_repo_health
description: Return a one-call triage snapshot of the entire repository: symbol counts, dead code %, average cyclomatic complexity, top 5 hotspots, dependency cycle count, and unstable module count. Designed to be the first tool called in any new session — one call gives a complete picture to guide follow-up analysis.

repo.description: Repository identifier (owner/repo or just repo name)

days.description: Churn look-back window for hotspot calculation (default 90).
